mechanism_narrative: A sustained 5-month decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below its 3-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate recessionary pressures.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below its 3-month moving average for 5 consecutive months
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below its 3-month moving average for 5 months but S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains above 4.5% for 3 months but S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 5.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: UNRATE remains above 5.5% for 3 months but S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

candidate_trigger: HOUST rises above its 6-month moving average for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: HOUST remains above its 6-month moving average for 3 months but S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
